concerns.text: FR-006 and FR-007 require a 'Gold Standard' dataset (n=20) for Judge Calibration and validation. Task T009a creates `data/gold_standard/human_annotations.json` but is marked [ ] (unstarted) and relies on a `calibration.schema.yaml` that is not yet created (T009a references it, but the schema creation task is missing). Without the schema and the data file, FR-006/FR-007 cannot be satisfied.

FR-001 requires strict semantic validation (lexical overlap > 0.4, cosine distance < 0.3). Task T012 implements this logic, but Task T010 (defining `axis.schema.yaml`) is marked [ ] (unstarted). The validation logic in T012 cannot be structurally verified or enforced without the schema defined in T010.

FR-002 requires generating 50 'Out-of-World' probes with semantic distance checks. Task T018 implements the check, but Task T016 (defining `probe.schema.yaml`) is marked [ ] (unstarted). The probe generation and validation logic lacks the required schema definition to enforce structure.

FR-003, FR-004, FR-005, FR-006, FR-007, and SC-001/SC-003 require a full execution pipeline (experiment runner, stats engine, aggregation, timing). Tasks T026a (aggregation), T027 (calibration), T028 (runner), T029 (timeout), T029a (timing), T030 (Shapiro-Wilk), T031 (test selection), T032 (results writer), T033 (stats test), and T035 (CLI entry) are all marked [ ] (unstarted). The core experimental execution and analysis required by US-3 is missing.

FR-002 requires a regeneration loop with a hard limit of 150 attempts and specific error handling ('Generation Limit Exceeded'). Task T020 (probes writer) and T021 (error handling) are marked [ ] (unstarted). The pipeline cannot handle the edge case of probe generation failure as required.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Principle III (Data Hygiene) require pinned seeds, `requirements.txt`, and experiment state tracking (run IDs, hashes). Task T003 (linting/formatting) and T008 (experiment state tracking) are marked [ ] (unstarted). The project lacks the infrastructure to guarantee reproducibility and data hygiene as mandated.

Task T011 is marked [X] (complete) but contains a comment 'SKIPPED: YAML+regex parse failed'. This indicates the task was not actually completed or the implementation is broken, yet it is marked as done. This is a stale/wrong status tag.

Task T009 (Unit test for axis semantic overlap) is marked [X] (complete) but the description states 'it depends on T010 (schema) and T011 (service) being implemented first'. Since T010 and T011 are marked [ ] (unstarted) or broken, T009 cannot logically be complete. This is a stale/wrong status tag.
